About Me

01 / ABOUT

I'm a BS Information Technology student at National College of Science and Technology (NCST). I enjoy working on practical school projects and turning ideas into interfaces and working systems.

I'm currently growing my programming skills rather than claiming to already be an expert. Most of my project experience comes from group development, UI/UX work in Figma, databases, file/project management, and AI-assisted development.

One of my strongest roles in our projects is UI/UX Designer & System Tester / Quality Reviewer. I regularly monitor our systems, look for mistakes or missing features, prepare lists of issues and recommendations, and communicate them to the developers so they can be addressed and improved.
